title: Trace Gmail ordinary API error classes to recovery advice
findings: Capture wraps KizukiError as 'Gmail ${code}; check enrollment, permissions or bounded source coverage' (packages/connector-gmail/src/state.ts:45-46, connector.ts:372-374). timeout, unreachable, rate_limited, and provider_error therefore share one non-actionable sentence.

Non-200 statuses other than 403/429 become HttpFailure and collapse to 'Gmail unavailable; check permissions or source coverage', losing HTTP status (api.ts:84-87, connector.ts:374). Residual 401 after the existing one refresh takes this path.
HTTP 403 reason domainPolicy is documented by Google as an admin/policy refusal and is currently provider_error (api.ts:82). User-visible text cannot name 'contact the domain administrator'.
HTTP 403 with a non-object error field is source_schema, not provider_error (api.ts:77-79 + state.ts:48-51). GmailFixture.failStatus=403 would take this path; only 429 is tested.

packages/cli/src/connections.ts:405-412 swallows every Gmail connect() failure into 'Gmail connection unavailable; check operator configuration and reauthorize the existing source.', so timeout and unauthenticated are indistinguishable at loadConnector.
History list 404 and message GET 404 already return success batches with history_gap_deletions_unreconciled / message_unavailable_no_deletion_inferred. They must not be converted into errors.

Existing tests already cover 429, 403 userRateLimitExceeded, history 404, message 404, timeout, misconfigured URL, 26th request, oversized JSON, missing KIZUKI_GMAIL_CLIENT_ID, and snapshot_gap. Do not duplicate those.
Live bun test of those files is NOT_RUN in this archive: @kizuki/core cannot be resolved and bun install is forbidden.
